readerCopy.body: A viral solution gathers belief faster than anyone can test whether it works. New platforms, anonymous funds, artificial images, or unverified tools spread through a crisis while users fill technical gaps with hope and rumor. Uranus accelerates the disruption and reach, while Neptune blurs what is real, useful, or accountable inside the excitement. The square makes every failure feel like a reason to believe the next version will finally deliver the promise. The innovation may change the field while leaving the people who needed help sorting through scams, confusion, and abandoned experiments.
